title: CaLMQA: Exploring culturally specific long-form question answering across 23 languages

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM performance (factuality, relevance, surface-level quality) on culturally specific long-form questions versus culturally agnostic questions using automatic claim verification pipelines, LLM-as-a-judge relevance scoring, and human evaluations by native speakers.

Measuring disparities in LLM answer quality and surface-level errors (such as answering in the wrong language, apologizing, or token repetition) across 23 diverse languages, explicitly contrasting model capabilities between high-resource and low-resource languages.
